config:
server:
  port: 8082
  servlet:
    context-path: /ors
ors:
  endpoints:
    isochrones:
      enabled: true
      maximum_locations: 1
      maximum_intervals: 1
      maximum_range_time_default: 3600
      maximum_range_time:
        - profiles: driving-hgv
          value: 3600
      fastisochrones:
        maximum_range_time_default: 3600
        maximum_range_time:
          - profiles: driving-hgv
            value: 3600
  engine:
    init_threads: 1
    profile_default:
      enabled: false
      graph_path: /home/ors/graphs
      build:
        source_file: /home/ors/files/germany.osm.pbf
        elevation: false
    profiles:
      driving-car:
        enabled: false
      driving-hgv:
        enabled: true
        encoder_name: driving-hgv
        build:
          elevation: false
          preparation:
            methods:
              fastisochrones:
                enabled: true
                threads: 1
                weightings: fastest
          ext_storages:
            HeavyVehicle:
              restrictions: true
